THIS WRIT PETITION (CRIMINAL) HAVING COME UP FOR ADMISSION ON 13.09.2024, THE COURT ON THE SAME DAY DELIVERED THE FOLLOWING:
 2024:KER:70283 W.P.(Crl.) No.964 of 2024  -:3:-
 BECHU KURIAN THOMAS, J.
 ---------------------------------------
 W.P.(Crl.) No.964 of 2024  ---------------------------------------
 Dated this the 13th day of September, 2024  JUDGMENT Petitioner is an accused in Crime No.1611/2023 of Ambalamedu Police Station, Ernakulam, alleging offences under Sections 420, 465, 468 and 471 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860.
The crime is still at the investigation stage.
In the meantime, petitioner obtained an employment at Bharat Petroleum Corporation Limited, and they insist on a Police Clearance Certificate to be produced.
When the petitioner applied for grant of such a clearance certificate, he was issued with Exhibit-P8 styled as 'NIOC - Rejection Notice'.
Petitioner challenges the said certificate and seeks for a direction to quash the said rejection notice and also to issue a Police Clearance Certificate.

sentences.text: 2. I have heard Sri. E.Adithyan, the learned counsel for the petitioner and Sri. Noushad.K.A, the learned Public Prosecutor.
3. The learned Public Prosecutor has informed that the investigation has already been completed and the final report has also been filed.
The said submission is recorded.

4. In a recent judgment of this Court in W.P.(Crl.) No.827/2024 dated 29.07.2024, it was observed that the title 'rejection notice' given 2024:KER:70283 on a certificate pursuant to an application for police clearance certificate renders the whole purpose of such a certificate to be ineffective and not serving any purpose.
Directions were issued to provide a certificate stating the existence or non-existence of any crime after omitting the words 'rejection notice'.
It was also observed that the certificate must be titled as a certificate issued under Section 59 of the Kerala Police Act, 2011 regarding involvement/non- involvement in offence.
If details of a crime or case pending are mentioned, it will be open for the employer or other person who demands such a certificate to consider the implication and apply their mind.

5. In view of the above, Exhibit-P8 issued to the petitioner being of no use, and on the other hand,
creates more prejudice to the petitioner for having applied for such a certificate, it is required to be quashed.
Ordered accordingly.

6. Further, there will be a direction to the second and third respondent or the competent amongst them to issue a certificate styled as a certificate regarding 'involvement/non- involvement in offences' pursuant to Exts. P5 and P6 applications filed by the petitioner stating whether he is involved in any crime, and if he is so involved, giving the crime number/case number, the offences alleged and also the stage of investigation or whether it is pending trial.
With the above observations, this writ petition is disposed of.
Needless to mention that the certificate as mentioned above shall be issued at the earliest, without undue delay.

Sd/-
BECHU KURIAN THOMAS JUDGE Jka/13.09.24
